Makhatilaka
dh. RORI. VIII. 56. XXI. 1695.
-or Grahmakhatilaka by Mādhava, son of Kṛṣṇācārya of Bharadvājagotra. BORI. 96 of 1892-95. BORI. D. VII. 401. Peters. V. p. 230 (no. 96). Extr. p.. 176-77.
See Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1158b.
-Homapaddhati from. Alwar 1545-46. Extr. no. 375. RASB. II. 1234.

Makhapākapaddhati
gṛh. p.. Kāty. by Śivaprasāda Pāṭhaka. RASB. II. 1155 (B).

Makhapradīpa
dh. by Kavi Bhāratī of Assam, son of great grandson of Halāyudha. Ani. Dharmanāth Sastri, Assam 52.
See J. of Assam Res. Soc. XIV. 1960. p.. 94-95.

Makhasvāmin
authority on dharmaśāstra. q. by Dhanvin in C. Dīpikā on Drāhyāyaṇaśrautasūtra. [Page-9b] IO. 4573; by Rudraskandasvāmin in his C. Audgātṛsārasaṅgraha on Drāhyāyaṇa-śrautasūtra. Oxf. 379b; by Vīrarāghava in his C. on Drāhyāyaṇaśrautasūtra. Br.. 55; by Rāmakṛṣṇa Nānābhai in Brahmatvapaddhati, PUL. I. p. 57; by Sāyaṇa in his C. on Mantrapraśna of Sāma Br., IO. 4348; in Somaprayoga (a..), PUL. I. p. 64; by Tālavṛntanivāsin in Chandogaśrautasūtraprayogapradīpikā, MD. 1039.
